Title: List the first page of photos
Steps / Request: Send GET /photos with page 1 and per_page 3
Expected Result: Status 200; response has data, page, per_page and total; each photo has id, title and download_url

Title: Walk two pages without repeats
Steps / Request: Send GET /photos for page 1 and page 2 with per_page 3
Expected Result: Status 200 for both pages; no photo id appears on both pages; total is the same on both pages

Title: Reject an unknown thumbnail format
Expected Result: Response is 400 or 404 JSON error, not 500 or 502

Title: Photo links point to the CDN folder
Download the PNG thumbnail
Expected Result: Status 200; Content-Type is image/png; body is not empty; the file signature is PNG; Cache-Control has max-age

Title: Resize a photo
Steps / Request: Send POST /resize with a photo id, a width and a height
Expected Result: Status 200; Content-Type is image/png; body is not empty

Title: Resize without a photo is rejected
Steps / Request: Send POST /resize with an empty JSON body

Title: Photos are sorted by title
Steps / Request: Send GET /photos with page 1 and per_page 3
Expected Result: Status 200; photos are sorted by title
